result.question: Why did Uzziah dig many cisterns?

readings.answer: Because he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain.
readings.support: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns.

assessments.reason: 2 Chronicles 26:10 explicitly says, “Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he ... dug many cisterns,” matching the answer verbatim.

result.reason: The passage explicitly gives the reason—his much livestock—so the provided answer matches the text and the key.
